scope: Two exact-harness route-free replays of official MCP SDK 2.3.1 client-generated host-budget exhaustion against a checksum-verified unsigned experimental Debian 12 amd64 package built from trusted main 92b2808. Each run used a fresh package installation in a disposable 128 MiB, 64 PID container with the installed server under a 64-FD soft limit.
tested_package_manifest: SHA256SUMS from exact-main CI run 42165266403; all three files verified before testing
reproduce: Install pinned SDK with npm ci --prefix tools/mcp-sdk-probe --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund; set OUTBOUND_GUARD_TEST_SDK_DIR to that directory, OUTBOUND_GUARD_TEST_SDK_PACKAGE to the verified .deb, OUTBOUND_GUARD_TEST_SDK_PACKAGE_SHA256 to its digest, then run bash tools/netns_adversarial_probe.sh target/debug/outbound-guard-mcp twice.
checks: In each run, 12 SDK AbortSignal cancellations and 48 allowed guarded calls spent 60 same-host minute slots in one installed server process. The 61st SDK guarded call returned isError EGRESS_RATE_LIMIT without body text; controlled DNS query and HTTP hit counts did not change across that call. Exact audit ordering and a subsequent SDK tools/list control passed. Twelve overload busy denials, cancelled socket closures and guarded recoveries also passed. Package hash/version/install, removal/residue and namespace/container cleanup passed.
sampling: In-container /proc server FD monitor requested 5 ms samples during the SDK sequence. Maximum sampled FD count is a lower bound on a possibly shorter transient peak; VmHWM is server-specific, while container memory and PID high-water include helpers.
limitations: One modern SDK client, one Debian package/OS/architecture, one short per-host window and two finite repeats. No multi-process budget sharing, reset-after-minute behavior, arbitrary concurrent load, other client-generated exhaustion, traffic through other tools, exact official candidate, owner residual-risk acceptance or independent human review is claimed. The four AI Scraping Defense repositories still require separate adversarial evidence.
